title: ChipBlocks shapes manifest
description: Layer 1 of the 9-layer abstraction hierarchy (per ADR-006). A shape is a region of space filled with a Layer-0 material. Shapes have geometry but no electrical role yet — that comes in Layer 2 (interfaces) and Layer 3 (behaviors). Each shape kind defines a different geometric primitive (solid region, thin film, wire path, plate, gap, layer, hole, junction). Shape parameters are typed (radius_mm, thickness_um, etc.) per the shape kind.

id.description: Shape kind id used by devices.yaml as a FK reference.

kind.description: Broad geometric category. Used by the validator and rendering UI.

parameters_required.description: Parameters a device must supply when using this shape. E.g., a cylinder requires { radius_mm, length_mm }; a wire_path requires { width_mm, length_mm, cross_section }.

default_material_category.description: The expected material category for this shape. Validators warn if a shape uses a material outside this category (e.g., a 'wire_path' shape filled with FR4 would be flagged).
